about: CafeMS service dependency matrix. Rows call columns. 2 = hard sync (the caller's flow stops without it), 1 = soft sync (tried now; the caller carries on degraded), 1A = soft async (queued; the caller does not wait), 0 = none. PAY and NOTIFY are external. Run: npm run deps:report

names.APP: Browser: public site and staff screens

why.APP->API: 2: no screen can load or save without the API.
why.APP->AUTH: 2: staff cannot work without signing in.
why.API->AUTH: 2: every request is checked against its session before anything else.
why.API->AUDIT: 2: an action that cannot be recorded does not happen (fail-secure).
why.API->DB: 2: all business data lives in the database.
why.API->PAY: 1: the charge is tried for up to 3 seconds; on a timeout the bill is saved as Pending Payment and can be retried.
why.API->QUEUE: 1A: receipts and staff notices are saved to the outbox in the same transaction and sent later.
why.AUTH->AUDIT: 2: a sign-in is recorded in the same transaction that creates the session.
why.AUTH->DB: 2: accounts and sessions are in the database.
why.AUDIT->DB: 2: entries are stored in the database.
why.PAY->API: 1A: the gateway's signed callback confirms a payment later; the till does not wait for it.
why.QUEUE->DB: 2: the worker reads its messages from the database.
why.QUEUE->NOTIFY: 1: delivery is tried now; a failure is retried with growing gaps and then raises an Admin alert.

differencesFromPlan: The plan had AUTH->QUEUE as 1A, but sign-in sends no messages, so it is 0. NOTIFY was added as its own external component, because the outbox worker calls it.
